title: Frontend
body:
Everything that runs on the user's machine, inside the browser: [[HTML]], CSS, and [[JavaScript]], the [[DOM]] they build, and any framework code such as [[React]]. The dining room of the restaurant — everything the guest sees and touches.

The single load-bearing consequence: **the user controls this environment completely**. DevTools can read every line of your JS, modify any variable, replay any request, and disable any check. So frontend code can hold presentation, interaction, and optimistic updates, but never trust — no [[Authorization]] decision, no secret key, no validation that actually matters may live here. Validate on the frontend for user experience and on the [[Backend]] for correctness. The two halves talk across an [[API]].
